role: The player-dependent half of one survival block break over a 3x3x3 cell context: ItemInWorldManager.tryHarvestBlock's order (onBlockHarvested, setBlockToAir with breakBlock and neighbour notify, canHarvestBlock, the held item's onBlockDestroyed and damage, harvestBlock), the harvestBlock overrides (shears, silk touch, ice to water, snow layers), the mineBlock/useItem/breakItem stats and the 0.025 exhaustion. The per-block drop table is delegated to drops.c. Checked against the oracle's HarvestDropsProbe.

notes: Called by dig.c. Only the 3x3x3 cells around the broken block are modelled; BlockTripWireHook's 41-block walk is reduced to its one sound draw, creative mode is out of scope, and onBlockDestroyedByPlayer is treated as empty (BlockSilverfish excluded). The in_water field of the local harvest_player in harvestdrops_break is left unset; can_harvest_block does not read it. Evidence recordings: out/java/harvestdrops (s2, s42). Java member names taken from this file's comments; the removeBlock, dropBlockAsItem_do and func_149855_e names were not checked against the Java files.
